reviews.text: Oraichain is an AI oracle network for smart contracts. Launched in 2020, it connects AI models to blockchain. In 2025, it has DeFi and prediction uses. Cosmos-based.

Oraichain is a Layer-1 blockchain designed to be an AI oracle network, it provides real-world data to blockchain applications through decentralized node validation. It’s like Chainlink plus machine learning, but on its own chain. Launched in 2020, it provides AI APIs (image recognition, search, etc) as on-chain services via blockchain oracles. The ORAI token fuels these services. Oraichain also targets blockchain interoperability, aiming to bridge data and AI across chains.

Oraichain strikes me as a very specialized project essentially an AI oracle for blockchains. It lets smart contracts call out to AI models, which is a cool concept that you don’t see elsewhere. In that respect I find it promising for future on chain AI apps. On the other hand, it’s fairly niche. Its success hinges on developers actually wanting to run AI inference on chain, which hasn’t become mainstream yet. So I view it as an interesting experiment, but its impact is still hypothetical.

Oraichain combines AI and blockchain by providing an AI powered oracle network, allowing smart contracts to access AI data and services. While it’s an exciting project with great potential, it’s still in its early stages and faces challenges in adoption and competition.
